test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Raghu sold an article at a loss of 15%. If he had bought the item at 5% less and had sold it for Rs. 195 more, then he would have gained 10%. Find the cost price (in Rs.) of the article.
solution: **Calculation:** Let the initial cost price of the article = 100x The selling price of the article when sold at 15% loss = 100x × 85/100 = Rs.85x Had the shopkeeper purchased the article for 5% less, the cost price = 100x × (100 - 5)/100 = Rs.95x
